text:
Good morning,

I am writing to express my interest in hiring your Orsini Veloce for a commercial shoot that I am involved in. We would like to collect the vehicle from your garage on Sat 4 Sep 2027 at 9.00am and return it on 5th September 2027 at 9.00am. I have attached my driving licence for your reference.

Thank you,
Imogen Holloway-Pike
+70 400 371 6781
